title: Shared definitions for the OSS Self-Hosting catalog contract
description: Primitive types reused by the product record, bundle and check definition schemas. This file defines no top-level type; it is referenced only.

schema_version.description: Contract version this document is written against. The validator refuses a version it does not support; see schemas/VERSIONING.md.

data_class.description: production: a real catalog document. fixture: test data, which may never live under catalog/.

slug.description: Lowercase, hyphen-separated identifier. Stable for the life of a listing and never reused for a different subject.

review_slug.description: The JuryPress review slug, e.g. talivia-group-talivia-acfdc1. Optionally carries a revision suffix. This repository stores the slug as a reference only; it never copies the review.

date.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD, interpreted as UTC. A date in the future is refused.

https_url.description: Absolute https URL. The validator additionally refuses credentials in the URL, IP-literal hosts and non-routable hosts.

repo_path.description: Path relative to the repository root. Never absolute, never containing '..'. The validator additionally requires the path to exist and to sit under the directory the field allows.

check_result.description: passed: performed and it worked. failed: performed and it did not work. not_tested: not performed. not_applicable: does not apply, and the reason says why.

work_state.description: How far preparation has got. None of these values is a public claim about the product.

listing_state.description: What this repository publicly says about the product. Only tested and experimental appear in the index.

template_type.description: Provenance of the deployment route, in the order this repository prefers them.
